purpose: Every committed Grove FHIR fixture outside a guide's input directory goes through the official HL7 FHIR Validator with the exact Grove packages. A guide's own worked examples are validated by the IG Publisher during its build and audited by Scripts/check-guide-qa.py; these fixtures are the ones no build ever sees, so a fixture that contradicts its claimed profile could otherwise ship. Every JSON file beneath the declared roots is either validated here or excluded with a reason, so a new fixture cannot be added unclassified.
